design.probe: Four seconds of pinned public recording delivered as 1280x720 H.264/4:2:0 at 24 or 25 fps.
design.picture: Frozen 80x60 and 160x90 grids and the original picture points.
design.timing: Two 200 ms shifts inside a 960 ms interval, with separate files for each edited delivery and the untouched reference. Use the existing waveform search.
design.pass: For each rate both carriers must locate at least half of planned edits and flag zero controls. Localization needs IoU of at least 0.60 and the signed movement within 16 samples.
